rules: Runtime agents may not edit this manifest or any frozen eval derived from it.
A model's claim that a feature passes is never evidence.
Only objective checks plus the independent harness gate may set passes=true.
A runtime error, failed acceptance check, or high-severity safety regression prevents pass.
Do not delete, weaken, or reinterpret criteria to make implementation easier.

features.title: Zero-setup Lite runtime
criteria: Packaged macOS app can start a persistent local Rakazo API without Docker, a separately installed PostgreSQL server, pnpm, or Terminal setup.
Lite /health reports the memory job driver and desktop computer provider.
A persisted record survives a full LocalRuntime stop/start cycle.

features.title: Lite / Full Local / Remote modes
criteria: First launch presents all three modes.
Choosing Full Local or Remote never silently starts Lite.
Mode/profile can be changed later through Connection Center.

features.title: No black-screen desktop failure
criteria: Unreachable configured server shows an actionable recovery screen.
Healthy origin is loaded only after a health check.
Renderer remains context-isolated with nodeIntegration disabled.

features.title: Preserve upstream reliability/security
criteria: Feature branch contains current upstream foundation.
Fork persona/social/Ollama/desktop value is preserved without reverting upstream reliability/security fixes.
DB migration numbering is conflict-free.

features.title: Any provider / any model escape hatch
criteria: Provider catalog unions shipped, synced, and custom models.
Custom model IDs survive sync and are routable even when /models omits them.
Arbitrary OpenAI-compatible base URLs are supported without hardcoded provider allowlists.

features.title: Supported subscription and OAuth routes
criteria: Upstream Pi OAuth including openai-codex remains functional.
Claude Code/Codex/Kimi/OpenCode integrations invoke the user's authenticated CLI rather than copying private tokens.
Z.ai Coding Plan is routed only through supported coding-tool paths unless direct use is officially supported.

features.title: Safe CLI agent bridge
criteria: Claude Code, Codex, Kimi Code, OpenCode and custom/Prime Agent capability probes exist.
Process execution uses argv not implicit shell interpolation, has timeout/cancel/output caps, and captures stderr.
Missing binary and unsupported mode produce actionable errors.

features.title: MCP stdio and Streamable HTTP
criteria: stdio performs initialize -> initialized -> tools/list and calls a real test tool.
Streamable HTTP handles JSON and SSE replies and validates local security expectations.
All subprocess paths reap children; destructive tools default disabled.

features.title: Canonical Markdown Brain Folders
criteria: User may attach multiple Markdown roots with per-root read/write policy.
Retrieval includes source path and heading.
Writes are proposed as diffs and traversal/symlink escape is rejected.
Frozen eval/safety roots cannot be configured agent-writable.

features.title: Maximum agent personality/customization
criteria: Agents retain name/title/color/persona and can set relationship role, traits, autonomy, skills/brain access, and role routing.
Personality affects stable agent instructions without weakening task verification or safety policy.
Existing Buzz/Lounge/social surfaces remain usable.

features.title: Hierarchical multi-agent orchestration
criteria: Orchestrator can assign architect/manager/researcher/builder/reviewer/judge/verifier/specialist roles.
Different roles may use different enabled providers/models.
Role/model/tool selection and handoffs are visible in run events/traces.

features.title: Long-horizon completion harness
criteria: Long task has immutable observable criteria, one current feature/stage, append-only progress and checkpoints.
Builder cannot mark its own feature passing.
Restart reconstructs current progress and avoids redoing accepted work.

features.title: Local/small-model mutation gate
criteria: Local worker edits are staged and cannot promote without external verification.
Failed check rolls back or rejects candidate.
Empty/invalid local response escalates or fails instead of being treated as success.

features.title: Objective verifier owns pass state
criteria: High judge score plus one runtime/acceptance failure results in failed feature.
Verifier evidence is stored with the transition.
Judge prose is at most a tiebreaker after objective checks.

features.title: Hierarchical run observability
criteria: Model and tool spans record parentage, duration, provider/model/role, usage/cost and errors.
Concurrent spans cannot corrupt parentage.
Circular/empty/context-drop/error-cascade heuristics each have positive and negative tests.

features.title: Token/cost/round guardrails
criteria: Per-call/run/day budgets and call/round/subagent limits are enforceable pre-call.
Budget exhaustion yields partial/incomplete status, never false success.
CPCT includes abandoned spend.

features.title: Golden traces and functional evals
criteria: Successful real run can be frozen as golden shape/totals/checks.
Comparison covers correctness/regressions before cost/tokens/calls/latency.
Best-of-N functional voting restores workspace state between candidates and does not use cached duplicate answers.

features.title: Feedback-driven agent growth
criteria: Thumb/note feedback is persisted and reused as compact standing guidance; corrections carry stronger weight than generic approval.
Accepted lessons/failures/remedies can be written to auditable brain Markdown.
General feedback prompts are rate-limited, optional, and user-disableable.

features.title: Safe self-improvement loop
criteria: Proposed harness/prompt/routing improvement is evaluated on a copy/checkpoint against frozen evals.
Runtime agent cannot write frozen eval or safety gate files.
Losing experiment is not promoted and its measured result can be recorded to prevent blind retry.

features.title: Upgradeability and capability discovery
criteria: Provider/model/CLI/MCP registries expose capability status rather than requiring central model allowlist edits.
New manual model ID can work without a Rakazo release.
One optional integration failure does not break app startup or other providers.

features.title: Integrated Agentic Slack UI
criteria: Runtime, Provider/Model, CLI, MCP, Brain, Agent Studio, Orchestration/Trace/Cost/Evals surfaces are reachable.
Chat/Buzz/Lounge remain first-class.
Disconnected/empty states are actionable and narrow-window/keyboard smoke passes.

features.title: Verified universal macOS package
criteria: Final reviewed commit passes required CI.
GitHub Actions produces universal macOS DMG.
DMG is tied to the reviewed final SHA and documented signing/notarization state is accurate.
